problems.reason: Sentence 6 claims Silurolepis lived during the Gorstian stage (426.7–425 Ma), but those dates do not correspond to the Gorstian stage, which is older; thus the stated stage and age conflict.

notes: - contradiction: "Silurolepis lived during the Ludlow epoch of the Silurian period." / "It lived between 426.7 and 425 million years ago during the Gorstian stage.": Sentence 6 claims Silurolepis lived during the Gorstian stage (426.7–425 Ma), but those dates do not correspond to the Gorstian stage, which is older; thus the stated stage and age conflict.
